name: Microsoft Planner
hint: An app registration in Microsoft Entra with these application permissions, admin-consented: Tasks.ReadWrite.All; the token address holds your directory ID.

endpoints.name: list_group_plans
endpoints.description: Lists the plans a Microsoft 365 group owns, by the group’s ID.

endpoints.name: list_plan_tasks
endpoints.description: Lists a plan’s tasks with their titles, buckets, assignees, due dates and percent complete; 100 is done.

endpoints.name: list_user_tasks
endpoints.description: Lists the tasks assigned to a user.

endpoints.name: get_task
endpoints.description: Returns one task; its description and checklist are in the task’s details.

endpoints.name: get_task_details
endpoints.description: Returns a task’s description, checklist items and references.

endpoints.name: list_plan_buckets
endpoints.description: Lists a plan’s buckets, the custom columns of its task board.

endpoints.name: list_bucket_tasks
endpoints.description: Lists the tasks in one bucket.

endpoints.name: get_plan
endpoints.description: Returns one plan: its title, who created it and the container, such as a group, that holds it.

endpoints.name: get_plan_details
endpoints.description: Returns a plan’s category names, category1 to category25, which a task’s appliedCategories refer to.

endpoints.name: create_task
endpoints.description: Creates a task in a plan, in a bucket of that plan; dates are ISO 8601 in UTC. Body: {"planId", "bucketId", "title", "dueDateTime", "assignments": {"<user id>": {"@odata.type": "#microsoft.graph.plannerAssignment", "orderHint": " !"}}}.

endpoints.name: create_bucket
endpoints.description: Creates a bucket, a column of the task board, in a plan. Body: {"name", "planId", "orderHint": " !"}.
